title: Evaluating the Robustness of Analogical Reasoning in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in model accuracy on story-analogy problems when the correct candidate answer is presented first versus when it is presented second to see if the model disproportionately favors the first option.

Evaluating whether models rely on superficial, sentence-level structural similarities rather than abstract causal reasoning by comparing accuracy on original story analogies against paraphrased versions of the correct targets.
